question: Who among the following was elected as the President of the Asian Cricket Council (ACC) in January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jay Shah.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Jay Shah was elected as the President of the Asian Cricket Council (ACC) in January 2021.
 
• He will take over the reins from Mr Nazmul Hassan, President of, the Bangladesh Cricket Board.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Asian Cricket Council was formed in New Delhi on 19th September 1983, as the Asian Cricket Conference.
 
• The aims and objectives as stated in the original constitution were "organizing, developing and promoting the game of cricket in Asia."
 
• The founding members of the ACC were Bangladesh, India, Malaysia, Pakistan, Singapore, and Sri Lanka.
